_comment: which is shared by python-escpos and escpos-php, so profiles are portable between projects.
Upstream data is licensed CC BY 4.0 - see doc/CREDITS.md for attribution.
The 'commands' block is a local extension. escpos-printer-db assumes standards-compliant
printers, but some units need vendor byte sequences around a job. Empty strings mean
'send nothing', which is correct for any standards-compliant printer.
Values are hex strings so this file stays plain JSON.

generic-58.name: Generic 58mm ESC/POS
generic-58.notes: Standards-compliant 58mm thermal printer. Safe default for most unbranded units, including the MPT-II.

generic-80.name: Generic 80mm ESC/POS
generic-80.notes: Standards-compliant 80mm receipt printer. Most desktop POS units with an auto-cutter.

ctp500.name: Core Innovation CTP-500
ctp500.notes: Original target device. Needs vendor sequences around each job; these are not portable to other printers. Native QR/barcode are disabled because the firmware is not known to implement them - content is rasterised instead.

nt-5890k.name: NT-5890K
nt-5890k.notes: Capabilities from escpos-printer-db. Common 58mm portable/handheld class.
